_comment: The caption check's claim values, read by `pave/drill.py` at run time (SPEC/11 constraint 3). The writer has no default for any of them: a missing owner, window, threshold or event exits 2 and writes nothing. Every value here is pinned in SPEC/11 ('Pinned here, and nowhere later') and in `milestones/M11/pre-registration/falsifiers.json`, and `tests/test_drill_pins.py` holds the three equal. This file is on AI Quality plus Platform Engineering (`pave/twokey.py`): it is the thermostat, and widening `max_gap_s` turns a NO-GO into a GO with every other test green.
